title: What is Netflix’s share of TV viewing? (Q2 2026)

facts.fact: Netflix accounted for 7.8% of all U.S. TV viewing in April 2026, according to Nielsen's The Gauge.
facts.quote: Netflix accounted for **7.8% of all U.S. TV viewing in April 2026**, according to Nielsen's The Gauge

facts.fact: YouTube held 13.4% of total U.S. TV viewing in April 2026 according to Nielsen's The Gauge as cited by the page.
facts.quote: **YouTube:** 13.4% of total TV viewing (the leader)

facts.fact: Total streaming accounted for 47.6% of all U.S. TV viewing in April 2026, a record high per Nielsen's The Gauge as cited by the page.
facts.quote: **Total streaming:** 47.6% of all TV viewing, a record high

facts.fact: Cable accounted for 21.6% of U.S. TV viewing in April 2026 per Nielsen's The Gauge as cited by the page.
Broadcast accounted for 19.9% of U.S. TV viewing in April 2026, below 20% for the first time per Nielsen's The Gauge as cited by the page.
facts.quote: **Broadcast:** 19.9%, below 20% for the first time

facts.fact: Nielsen released the April 2026 Gauge report on June 25, 2026.
facts.quote: In the [April 2026 report](https://www.nielsen.com/news-center/2026/sports-and-dramas-drive-april-viewing-patterns-in-nielsens-latest-gauge-reports/), released June 25, 2026

facts.fact: Netflix's share of U.S. TV viewing was roughly 9% in January 2026, boosted by the Stranger Things finale, per the page.
facts.quote: Netflix ran closer to 9% back in January 2026, lifted by the finale of Stranger Things

facts.fact: Netflix's ad-supported tier reached more than 250 million monthly active viewers globally by its May 2026 upfront presentation, up from 190 million in late 2025, per TheWrap as cited by the page.
facts.quote: Netflix's ad tier reached [more than 250 million monthly active viewers](https://www.thewrap.com/media-platforms/streaming/netflix-ad-tier-monthly-active-viewers-update-upfronts-2026/) globally by its May 2026 upfront presentation, up from 190 million in late 2025.

facts.fact: In countries where Netflix's ad plan is offered, more than 60% of new sign-ups choose the ad-supported plan, per the page.
facts.quote: In the countries where the ad plan is offered, more than 60% of new sign-ups now choose it.

facts.fact: Netflix ended 2024 with more than 301 million paid memberships worldwide, its last officially reported count before it stopped disclosing quarterly subscriber numbers.
facts.quote: Netflix ended 2024 with more than 301 million paid memberships worldwide, its last officially reported count

facts.fact: Adwave states the minimum budget to start advertising on connected TV with Adwave is $50.
facts.quote:
$50

Minimum to start advertising on connected TV with Adwave

facts.fact: Netflix's U.S. TV viewing share was up about 0.3 points in April 2026 versus April 2025, putting it near 7.5% in April 2025 per the page.
facts.quote: Year over year, Netflix was up about 0.3 points in April versus a year earlier, a modest gain that put it near 7.5% in April 2025.

facts.fact: Nielsen delayed its March 2026 Gauge amid a dispute with streamers over a new measurement approach, with the recalibrated methodology pushed to the start of fall.
facts.quote: Nielsen delayed its March 2026 Gauge amid a dispute with streamers over a new measurement approach

facts.fact: Adwave states that ad creation on its platform is free.
facts.quote: With Adwave, ad creation is free, a campaign starts at a $30-a-day minimum, and you can be live across 100+ premium streaming channels in under 10 minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a campaign on its platform starts at a $30-per-day minimum.
facts.quote: a campaign starts at a $30-a-day minimum

facts.fact: Adwave states that a user can be live across 100+ premium streaming channels in under 10 minutes.
facts.quote: you can be live across 100+ premium streaming channels in under 10 minutes

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance suggests setting a geographic targeting radius of usually 15 to 25 miles for a local service area.
facts.quote: Set a geographic radius, usually 15 to 25 miles

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance suggests planning enough spend to reach the same households several times over two to three weeks.
facts.quote: Plan enough spend to reach the same households several times over two to three weeks.

facts.fact: Adwave claims its AI tools can turn an existing website into a 30-second ad in about two minutes.
facts.quote: AI tools turn your existing website into a broadcast-quality 30-second ad in about two minutes

facts.fact: Netflix was the second most-watched individual streaming service in the U.S. at 7.8% of total TV viewing in April 2026, behind YouTube.
facts.quote: Netflix is the second most-watched individual streaming service in the U.S., at 7.8% of total TV viewing in April 2026

facts.fact: YouTube held 13.4% of total TV viewing in April 2026, the top individual streaming service share cited in the page.
facts.quote: behind YouTube's 13.4%

facts.fact: Streaming took a record 47.6% of all TV viewing in April 2026, more than cable and broadcast combined.
facts.quote: took a record 47.6% of all TV viewing in April 2026

facts.fact: Netflix's ad revenue grew roughly 2.5 times in 2025 to more than $1.5 billion, according to the page.
facts.quote: Netflix's ad revenue grew roughly 2.5 times in 2025 to more than $1.5 billion

facts.fact: Netflix expects its ad revenue to roughly double toward $3 billion in 2026.

facts.fact: More than 4,000 advertisers were on Netflix's ad platform by the end of 2025.
facts.quote: More than 4,000 advertisers were on the platform by the end of 2025.
